instruction: A square tabletop gaming terrain tile of a rocky hillside: a slab base topped with a sloped hill surface, protruding rocky crags, a shallow winding footpath, and one broken low retaining wall. Wargaming diorama scale.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a tabletop terrain tile of a rocky hillside. A square tabletop gaming terrain tile of a rocky hillside: a slab base topped with a sloped hill surface, protruding rocky crags, a shallow winding footpath, and one broken low retaining wall. Wargaming diorama scale. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
